challenge.method: Compare physical page 118 with the kernel sentence in the same paragraph, the general address-space inventory on page 13, and the buffer discussion on page 119.

limitations: The scope is the graphics pointer or reference argument described in §4. Other input forms, kernels and host API arguments have separate rules.
